status: Defined before relevance model training and validation policy search
task: Re-rank original Diginetica query candidates against distinct observed query-associated clicks
session: Supplied sessionId restricted to one eventdate; query-time prefix of strictly earlier clicks from other queries
validation_selection: Maximize mean ILD@10 subject to at most 2% relative mean NDCG@10 loss against relevance ranker
bootstrap: 1000 paired resamples of supplied session IDs, seed 4285; query-weighted means
primary_comparison: Adaptive diversity policy versus fixed weight and history-only gate, same relevance model and candidates
secondary_comparison: Session progression heuristic and within-history-count shuffled diversity control
interpretation: Offline observed-click ranking and lexical diversity; cannot identify policy-induced clicks, user satisfaction, sales, or causal change in intent
